list.name: contributor
list.label: Contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1

list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

list.name: board
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM boards ORDER BY name
list.label: Issue board

options.content: **The stages do not multiply.** 70% adoption × 80% engagement × 60% assisted work is not a productivity figure — it is arithmetic on unrelated denominators. Each stage answers its own question on its own denominator.

panels.title: Stage 1 · Adoption

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'contributors using an agent' AS `stage`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.repo_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.contributor END) AS `value`
FROM whodunit_repos r
LEFT JOIN whodunit_events e ON e.repo_id = r.repo_id AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
WHERE r.contributor <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'contributors seen at all',
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.contributor)
FROM whodunit_repos r WHERE r.contributor <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
How many people used an agent at all, against how many are known to this tool.

The denominator is contributors with a recorded identity — a repository instrumented without one is invisible here, which is worth knowing before reading the ratio as coverage.

panels.title: Stage 2 · Engagement — how deep, not how many

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN s.mcp_calls > 0 OR s.distinct_tools >= 5 THEN 'agentic — MCP or many tools'
         WHEN s.tool_calls >= 50 THEN 'multi-file work'
         WHEN s.tool_calls >= 10 THEN 'wrote code'
         WHEN s.tool_calls > 0   THEN 'light edits'
         ELSE 'conversation only — no edits'
       END AS `intensity`,
       COUNT(*) AS `sessions`
FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = s.repo_id
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY `intensity` ORDER BY `sessions` DESC

panels.description:
Sessions bucketed by what actually happened in them, from conversation-only up to agentic work using MCP or many tools.

Depth rather than count, deliberately: ten sessions that produced nothing and one that rewrote a subsystem are not the same adoption, and a session count treats them identically.

panels.title: Habitual use (WAU / MAU)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=s.repo_id
   WHERE s.last_seen >= (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 7*86400) * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')) * 100.0
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id=s.repo_id
   WHERE s.last_seen >= (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 30*86400) * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')), 0), 0) AS v

panels.description:
Weekly actives over monthly actives — whether use is habitual or occasional.

A high ratio means the people who use it use it regularly. It says nothing about how many people that is, which is stage 1.

panels.title: Sessions doing real work

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.tool_calls > 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = s.repo_id
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Share of sessions that edited a file, as opposed to conversation that produced no change.

Conversation is not waste — planning and reading are work. This measures how much of the tool's use reached the codebase, not how much of it was useful.

panels.title: Stage 3 · AI-assisted work

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'agent lines survived to the commit' AS `stage`,
       SUM(c.method = 'intersected') AS `commits`
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  1=1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
UNION ALL
SELECT 'carries an attribution trailer',
       SUM(c.status = 'assisted')
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commits in range',
       COUNT(*)
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE 1=1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}') AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.description:
Share of commits carrying evidence of agent involvement.

Undetermined is not 'no AI was used' — it is 'no evidence either way'. A commit made before the hooks were installed, or on a machine without them, lands there regardless of how it was written (NAV-21).

panels.title: Stage 4 · Cycle time — assisted vs not

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN ai = 1 THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'not assisted' END AS `group`,
       ROUND(AVG(ltm)/60, 1) AS `hours`
FROM (
  SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
         COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  LEFT JOIN issue_commits gc ON gc.issue_id = i.id
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = gc.commit_sha
  WHERE w.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  bi.board_id = '$board'
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes
) t GROUP BY ai

defaults.noValue: no commits cite this board’s issue keys

panels.description:
Median PR cycle time, split by whether the work was assisted.

**Not a controlled comparison.** An agent is reached for on some kinds of work and not others, so part of any gap measures which work was assigned rather than what the agent did to it. Read it as a difference between two populations, not as an effect.

panels.title: Stage 5 · Cost per delivered line

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT SUM(s.output_tokens)
     FROM whodunit_sessions s JOIN whodunit_repos r2 ON r2.repo_id = s.repo_id
    WHERE   s.output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r2.contributor = '${contributor:raw}'))
  / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(c.lines_added + c.lines_removed)
     FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r3 ON r3.repo_id = c.repo_id
    WHERE c.status = 'assisted' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r3.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')), 0)
) AS v

defaults.noValue: no tokens or no assisted lines recorded

panels.description:
Output tokens spent per line of assisted work that reached a commit.

**This is output per unit of effort — stage 5's actual question — and it is not a productivity gain.** It has no before to compare against; it says what the work cost, not whether that is better than the alternative.

Tokens, never currency: under a subscription the marginal cost of a token is zero, so a price table would report money nobody spent.

panels.title: Stage 5 · Rework rate, assisted

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.purpose = 'fix' AND c.status = 'assisted')
  / NULLIF(SUM(c.status = 'assisted'), 0), 1) AS v
FROM whodunit_commits c JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Share of assisted commits labelled as fixes — a rework proxy.

**Not a defect rate.** `purpose` comes from Conventional Commit prefixes and path heuristics, so it measures what commits were labelled, not what broke.

**Read the banded version on the delivery dashboard before concluding anything.** Unbanded, assisted work looks better than unassisted (28.4% against 33.3%); split by change size that reverses in the middle band. The single figure here is a size-mix artefact and is shown as an entry point, not an answer.

panels.title: Stage 5 · Pre-adoption baseline

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT(b.commits, ' commits / ', b.window_days, 'd') AS v
FROM whodunit_baselines b JOIN whodunit_repos r ON r.repo_id = b.repo_id
WHERE ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR r.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
ORDER BY b.captured_at DESC LIMIT 1

defaults.noValue: no baseline captured for this repository

panels.description:
The pre-adoption window this repository can be compared against — captured by `dun baseline capture` and published by `dun sync` (NAV-107).

**A pre-instrumentation baseline is not a no-AI baseline.** Commits in that window may have been AI-assisted and simply not recorded, so it is a comparison against 'before we measured', not against 'before we used it'.

The window is fixed at capture and immutable afterwards, because a window chosen after seeing the result can manufacture almost any figure.

Empty means no baseline was captured — not that the repository had no activity before instrumentation.

options.content:
### Where the funnel stops

**Stage 5 measures cost and rework, not gain** — a gain needs the same work done both ways. Selection is not random (the cohorts are different populations), the baseline is pre-instrumentation rather than pre-AI, and change size is not output.

**Stage 6 · Business value is not measurable here, and not a gap to close.** Revenue, customer outcomes and time-to-market are what a business cares about; nothing in a git history or agent transcript reaches them. The stage stays because deleting it would imply stage 5 answers *was it worth it*. It does not.
